flags.name: routes
flags.note: Gates the GPX route feature — the routes panel and its upload/list/rename/delete endpoints (SNOW-686) and the map route overlay (SNOW-687). Add specific users via the Users field to invite non-superuser beta testers.

flags.name: slope_layer
flags.note: Gates the SNOW-691 map Terrain overlay — the swisstopo slope-angle raster (ch.swisstopo.hangneigung-ueber_30), its layers-menu row and its legend section. Ships ON FOR EVERYONE; swisstopo is credited in the map legend's "Map data" section and on /colophon/. Open item: swisstopo's layersConfig marks this layer "chargeable": true and that flag's meaning is unconfirmed (opendata.swiss and its CKAN API both 403 automated fetches), so the licence position is worth confirming with geodata@swisstopo.ch.

flags.name: sync_log
flags.note: Gates the SNOW-482 sync-log panel (manage page) and its matching /help/ section — a read-out of the client-side log:sync IndexedDB store of recent real server round-trips.
